Prices confirmed by heinx on 20 Nov 2026. The three QR rows (Rendang, Soto Betawi, Buntut Balado) carry the QR menu prices.
askOwner: Are the Talabat prices the dine-in prices? Most look like delivery prices.

Is the Talabat export complete? The QR menu has dishes not in it: Gado Gado, Karedok, Spring Roll Vegetable, Crispy Calamari, Crispy Wonton, Martabak Telor, Indonesian Style Siomay, Seafood Laksa, Soto Ayam, Paket Rendang (169) and Nasi Liwet (179) sharing platters, Martabak Manis, Dadar Gulung, Ice Cendol and more. Which should we add?
Vegan or vegetarian: Talabat says vegetarian for several dishes the QR menu lists as vegan. Which wording is right for each dish?
Seafood Combo: Talabat 149, QR menu 179. This is the other way round to most dishes. Which price is right?
Name conflict: Cakwe (Talabat) or Ca Kwe (QR menu)? We kept Cakwe.
Name conflict: Tahu Gejerot (Talabat) or Tahu Gejrot (QR menu)? We kept Tahu Gejerot.
Talabat name typo: Kerupuk (Garlic crakers). Fix it to crackers? We kept the Talabat spelling.
